definition: what the colours on a stoplight bar of mine are pinned to, and why they move

settled:
A stoplight of mine is pinned to my own distribution rather than to anything absolute. Yellow is my middle, and green and red are each about a standard deviation out from it.

So the anchors move when the distribution moves. Recovery raising my baseline recalibrates them.

I expect to redefine them several times over before a bar of mine climbs off the stoplight and onto numbered levels.
